## Quick Start

### OpenClaw (Unbrowse) workflow
- Authenticate in the browser first (no credentials are shipped with this skill).
- Capture fresh auth locally: run `unbrowse_capture` on an authenticated page for this domain.
- Execute via backend gate + client browser executor: `unbrowse_replay` with `executionMode="backend"`.

Example:
```text
unbrowse_replay { service: "munichre", executionMode: "backend", endpoint: "GET /en/{enJwt}" }
```

```typescript
// Authenticate and retrieve a data access token.
async function getAccessToken(cyberToken: string, cyberJwt: string): Promise<any> {
  try {
    const authResponse = await client.get_en_insights_cyber_cyberToken_cyberJwt({ cyberToken, cyberJwt });
    return authResponse;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error authenticating:", error);
    throw error;
  }
}
```

```typescript
// Retrieve data using a JWT.
async function retrieveData(enJwt: string): Promise<any> {
  try {
    const data = await client.get_en_enJwt({ enJwt });
    return data;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error retrieving data:", error);
    throw error;
  }
}
```

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Munichre's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Munichre data without official API access
- Automate actions on www.munichre.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Munichre frontend uses

import { MunichreClient } from "./scripts/api.ts";

## Error Handling

```typescript
try {
  const data = await client.get("/resource");
} catch (err) {
  if (err.message.includes("401")) {
    // Auth expired — need to re-capture
    console.error("Auth expired, re-run unbrowse_login");
  } else {
    console.error("API error:", err.message);
  }
}
```
